name: Task files operations: backup beside the project, checked restore, verify, purge, proxy check
summary: admin.py backup mirrors projects/NAME/.task-files into backups/NAME.task-files: the bytes a record names and every journal entry, re-hashed while copied (a file that no longer matches its name is reported, not copied), incremental, manifest.json written last; the status file records task_files, and backup-copy carries the folder. restore-new checks every file against the manifest before placing any; a mismatch places none and exits 3. task-files verify re-hashes what the records need (exit 1 on a problem). task-files purge (operator allowlist, --dry-run, project lock, one audit line) removes withdrawn files, files of tasks closed before a date, and orphans and temp files older than a day, never a file a live record needs, and marks entries purged (download 410). task-files proxy-check --url sends an unsigned upload of the per-file limit; Orchestra's own 401 passes. A refused upload is closed lingering (5 s, 64 MiB, at most 8 at once); its discard waits at most 10 s and never replaces the refusal.
